title: From Data to Decisions: Marketing Analytics, Mental Performance, and Firm Growth in an Emerging Market
authors: Stephen J. Anderson; Pradeep K. Chintagunta; Rupali Kaul; Naufel J. Vilcassim
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with 550 Rwandan firms (treatment, placebo, control arms). All estimates are cross-sectional endline regressions: reg y Treatment Placebo [b_y], vce(robust) (ANCOVA with the baseline outcome), IV (ivreg2 analytics_complier = Treatment), dose-response on visit_duration and compliance, and spillover interactions with competitor proximity (Code.do). No panel FE, no staggered adoption.
design_notes: Baseline-endline survey data (All_Data.dta), intervention July 2019-January 2020, robust SEs.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: RCT endline cross-section with single common intervention start; no unit/time FE

data_files_note: README.txt names the do file Rwanda_Study_vReplication_vFF.do; the package ships it as Code.do.
data_provenance_note: Experimental survey data shipped as collected.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. Not a DiD design; not a near-miss.
